en.title: People's Assembly Hearing with the Minister of Education
en.subtitle: English translation of the livestream transcript (Al-Souriya TV), 14 September 2026.
en.summary: The Minister of Education, Mohammad Abdulrahman Tarkou, appears before the People's Assembly at the third sitting of its first extraordinary session. Members ask about school capacity, dismissed and contract teachers, school restoration, curricula, exams and private education, and the minister presents the ministry's plans and answers their questions.
speakers: Minister of Education Mohammad Abdulrahman Tarkou
MP Waddah, Chair of the Education Committee
Al-Souriya TV anchor and studio guests
